string.text: Handheld flashlight with increased brightness and range.

An ultra-precise weapon that was assembled by the designers in the Zone. It harvests the energy of artifacts to be able to fire. Despite the collosal power of the shot, the recoil of the Gauss cannon is very low. The first version of the Gauss Cannon in the Zone.\nAmmunition - energy tanks with ready-to-use fatal elements in the magazine for the Gauss-GSG5 rifle.
Energy canisters with ready-to-use fatal elements in the magazine for the Gauss-GSG5 rifle.

The OTs-12 Tiss is a Russian assault rifle developed by the Central Design and Research Bureau of Sporting and Hunting Arms (TCDBSH), and based on the AKS74U. The key difference is the use of special subsonic 9x39mm cartridges (SP-5 and SP-6), which resulted in changes in the barrel, blowback device, bolt mirror dimensions and the magazine. The sight and muzzle brake-compensator were also modified.

This weapon is of unknown origin. It looks like an ordinary double-barrelled shotgun.
Ammunition:
12x70 shot,
12x76 slug,
12x76 dart.
Experimental weapon of unknown origin.\nAmmunition is 2mm gauss ammunition.
VSK-94 (Voyskovoy Sniper Complex) is a Russian sniper rifle based on the small-sized 9A-91 assault rifle developed by the KBP Instrument Design Bureau in 1994 for silent and flameless sniper fire.
A 7.62x54 caliber gravipatron, with shared elements from the Gravi artifact.

The PP-19 Bison submachine gun was designed in the early 1990s at the Izhevsk Machine Building Plant to arm the Ministry of Internal Affairs with a modern small-size automatic small arms weapon to replace the AKS-74U.
- 9x18mm, 9x18mm BMP
- effective range 100m
- magazine capacity 64 rounds

Six-barrel machine gun with electrically driven barrel rotation. It can be used as a hand weapon only with a hydraulic exoskeleton. It is very rare inside the Zone due to inconvenience of use in the field. The army uses it for perimeter defense against mutant swarms.

The weapon consists of a 9x39mm automatic rifle and a 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher. The automatic rifle operates by expelling powder gases from the barrel channel, and locking the barrel by rotating the bolt. The rifle is built in bullpup configuration, and one of the most significant disadvantages of this configuration was solved - displacement of the center of mass of the weapon and close to the shooter's face location of the extractor, which leads to the fact that the weapon, intended for use by right-handed shooters, cannot be used by left-handed shooters, because the hot fired cartridges fly into their faces. The first disadvantage was eliminated by the underbarrel grenade launcher, and a special channel was made for the shell casings, through which the casings were carried forward and discharged outside on the right side next to the pistol grip. Later, a similar scheme was used in Belgian FN F2000 rifle. Closed receiver also protects the receiver from dirt, which has a positive effect on the reliability of the rifle.
Underbarrel grenade launcher for AKS-74U prototype.

Prototype of the AKS-74U assault rifle. Often found among military stalkers. Kalashnikov 5.45 mm assault rifle (GRAU index - 6P20) developed in 1970 by Soviet designer M. T. Kalashnikov and adopted by the USSR Armed Forces in 1974. It is a further development of the AKM.

Kalashnikov assault rifle of 5.45 mm caliber, developed in 1970 by Soviet designer M.T. Kalashnikov and adopted by the USSR Armed Forces in 1974. It is a further development of the AKM. The development of the AK-74 is related to the transition to a new low-pulse 5.45 mm cartridge.

The third-generation man-portable air defense system Igla successfully operates in conditions of natural (background) and artificial interference (false thermal targets), to this day remaining one of the best weapons in its class.

Application:
Turn on the power supply.
Within 5 seconds, the missile is placed on alert by cooling the homing head to operating temperature and spinning up the gyroscope of the target tracking coordinator.
Aim the launcher at the target. When the target appears in the GSN field of view, the thermal radiation flux hits the coordinator. If the flux is greater than the minimum sensitivity of the coordinator, an audible alarm sounds. The target is acquired and the launch lock is released.
When the audible signal is present, the missile is launched. The power supply remains operational for about 40 seconds after it is turned on. If the missile is not launched within this time, the missile is unusable. Target acquisition is not possible when the angle between the target and the Sun is less than 20 degrees.

Ammunition:
Guided Igla Missile.
Needle missile in a launch tube

Guided Igla Missile contained in a launch tube. The missile uses a two-channel infra-red GSN, which provides high noise immunity of the missile against natural and artificial thermal interference. The fuze ensures detonation of the warhead both on direct hit and when flying in close proximity to the target. To increase efficiency, the residual fuel of the missile is detonated along with the warhead.

Rumor has it that this barrel was found in a pile of rust at the dump. The same place where the gravitational anomaly was located for three months. Surprisingly, the barrel itself hasn't rusted through. On the contrary - many shots have been fired from it, and the wear and tear is still not noticeable.\nFeatures: Inferior to the regular Kalashnikov in accuracy and damage, but lighter and more agile.\nBy its size and weight, the AKS-74U is closer to a submachine gub, but due to the cartridge and mechanisms used, it is still considered to be a shortened assault rifle. The advantages of the AKS-74U are high mobility in cramped conditions, possibility of concealed carry, rather high penetration capacity of the cartridge. The disadvantages are short sighting range, low stopping power of the bullet, and tendency to overheat during firing. Magazine capacity is 30 rounds. Basic ammunition is 5.45x39 FMJ, armor-piercing cartridge is 5.45x39 AP.
Thermobaric grenade for the GM-94 grenade launcher.

The GM-94 hand-held multi-round grenade launcher was developed by the KBP Design Bureau in the early 1990s. The main purpose of the new weapon was to provide fire support for infantry in close combat, especially in urban areas, as well as for police special operations. A variety of 43mm unitary rounds were developed specifically for the GM-94, including high-explosive fragmentation grenades, tear gas grenades, and rubber bullet rounds.

The Kalashnikov 5.45 mm handgun (RPK-74, GRAU Index - 6P18) is a handgun designed to replace the 7.62 mm RPK machine gun as part of the small arms system for the 5.45 mm low-pulse cartridge. It was adopted into service in 1974 along with the AK74 assault rifle.

The GSh-18 is a Russian pistol developed in the late 1990s by the KBP Design Bureau. It was named after the first letters of the surnames of the designers under whose supervision it was designed (Vasily Gryazev and Arkady Shipunov) and the number "18", meaning the magazine capacity.
Ammunition:
basic 9x19mm Parabellum,
improved 9x19mm PBP.
A prototype Gauss rifle with an enlarged magazine.
The personal knife of a stalker, nicknamed Crowbar. The handle is rubbed, but the knife fits perfectly in the hand.
Halogen flashlight. Experimental sample, possible malfunctions.

Features: with the help of modification of the bolt it was possible to increase the speed of the SVU, unfortunately at the cost of reduced accuracy.\nA more modern version of the Dragunov rifle made with a bullpup configuration. Very convenient for traveling in the Zone, a compact version of the powerful automatic sniper rifle. It's hard to get, unless you take it from a military stalker after a battle. The magazine capacity is 10 rounds. Basic ammunition - 7.62X54 7h1, armor-piercing cartridge - 7.62X54 AR, sniper ammunition with improved characteristics 7.62X54 7h14.

Features: The barrel is sprayed with powder obtained from a gravitational artifact.\nThe G36 assault rifle is a first-class example of modern German weaponry - it is lightweight, reliable and easy to handle. The magazine capacity is 30 rounds. Basic ammunition is 5.56X45 SS190, armor-piercing round is 5.56X45 AP. 40mm M203 grenades are used as ammo for the underbarrel grenade launcher. Weapon is used by veterans or masters.

Unique copy with improved optics.\nFeatures: Rifle with gift inscription. In addition to the inscription, the rifle has been tweaked to improve accuracy.\nSniper-Special Rifle. Designed for silent and flashless sniper shooting. The rifle has an integrated silencer. Very "respected" gun in the Zone. From 400 meters it can penetrate any body armor, which anyone can do without assistance. At the same time, it can be done almost silently. Weapon used by experienced and veteran stalkers. The capacity of the magazine is 20 rounds. Basic ammunition - 9x39 PAB-9, 9x39 AP armor-piercing cartridge, 9x39 SP-5 - sniper cartridge.

Good reliability.\nFeatures: modified version of the popular pistol. Created in the scientists' bunker specifically for self-defense in expeditions.\nThe Beretta is in service with the U.S. Armed Forces, many other paramilitary and law enforcement groups, police, both in the U.S. and other countries. The caliber is 9mm. Magazine capacity is 15 rounds. Basic ammunition is 9x19 FMJ, and improved ammunition is 9x19 PBP.
Basic cartridge for Colt M1911, Sig-Sauer P220, USP Compact, Desert Eagle pistols. Simple core, jacketed bullet.
The so-called Hydra-shok. A cartridge with improved characteristics for Colt M1911, Sig-Sauer P220, USP Compact, Desert Eagle pistols. Expansive bullet with good stopping power.

A common 12-gauge cartridge loaded with 6mm shot. At close ranges, it has tremendous killing power. It is intended for the shotguns TOZ-34, BM-16, Mossberg 88, SPAS-12, Protecta, Striker. Most effective at ranges up to 30 meters.

Pointed bullet stabilized in flight, which has a positive effect on accuracy. For the shotguns TOZ-34, BM-16, Mossberg 88, SPAS-12, Protecta, Striker. Increased range and armor-piercing ability - effective at ranges up to 150 meters.

A cartridge with a heavy breech-loading bullet. Usually used for hunting large animals, but it is also suitable for other purposes. Its heavy bullet does not penetrate, but actually squeezes through body armor. Designed for shotguns TOZ-34, BM-16, Mossberg 88, SPAS-12, Protecta, Striker. Effective at ranges up to 100 meters.
Armor-piercing cartridge for AKS-74 and AKS-74U rifles. Improved armor-piercing ability of the bullet.
Standard cartridge for AKS-74 and AKS-74U rifles. Simple core, jacketed bullet.
Armor-piercing bullet for L85, LR-300, Sig-550, G36, FN-2000 assault rifles.
Standard NATO cartridge, commonly known by the Belgian index SS109. Used in L85, LR-300, Sig-550, G36, FN-2000 assault rifles.
Low-cost modification of sniper cartridge for SVD, SVU-AS sniper rifles and PKM machine gun.
A sniper cartridge for SVD, SVU-AS and PKM sniper rifles. It has improved accuracy and range characteristics.
Armor-piercing bullet cartridge. For SVD, SVU-AS and PKM sniper rifles.
Basic cartridge for PM, PB, Fort-12, APS pistols. Simple core, jacketed bullet. Weak armor-piercing effect.

Ammunition with improved ballistic characteristics for PM, PB, Fort-12, APS pistols. Due to higher muzzle velocity of the bullet it is much more effective than conventional cartridge. More pronounced armor-piercing effect.
Ammunition with improved characteristics for PM, PB, Fort-12, APS pistols. Powerful cartridge with expansive bullet and armor-piercing core.
Basic cartridge for HPSA, Walther P-99, Beretta92FS, GSh-18 pistols. Sheathed bullet. Weak armor-piercing effect.
Improved performance cartridge for HPSA, Walther P-99, Beretta92FS, GS-18 pistols. Powerful cartridge with expansive bullet and armor-piercing core.
Armor-piercing cartridge for Groza, Val and special Vintorez sniper rifle. It has subsonic velocity, but due to the special bullet design it penetrates most body armor at ranges up to 400 meters.

Cartridge for Groza, Val and special Vintorez sniper rifle. A later and cheaper modification of the armor-piercing cartridge. It has subsonic velocity, but due to the special bullet design it penetrates most body armor at ranges up to 300 meters.
Sniper cartridge for Groza, Val and special Vintorez sniper rifles. It has subsonic flight speed, but due to heavy bullet of special design it penetrates most body armor at ranges up to 400 meters.
Energy tanks with ready-to-use killing elements in the magazine for Gauss rifle.
Grenade for M203 underbarrel grenade launcher. Used in LR-300, G36, Sig-550, L85 assault rifles and for integrated grenade launcher in FN-2000.
Fragmentation grenade for RPG-7B. Equally effective against both manpower and lightly armored vehicles.
Standard grenade for GP-25 Kostyor underbarrel grenade launcher, Groza integrated underbarrel grenade launcher and RG-6 revolver grenade launcher.

Grenade for the GP-25 Kostyor underbarrel grenade launcher, Groza integrated underbarrel grenade launcher and RG-6 revolver grenade launcher. Before detonation, the grenade jumps up to a height of about a meter, which increases its impact effect.
Hand defense grenade with a large fragmentation radius. It is recommended to throw it only from cover.
Hand smoke grenade. Designed to set up smoke cover. The action time is 10 seconds.
Offensive hand grenade. Shrapnel damage radius is small.

It is a further development of the Kalashnikov assault rifle. The main change compared to its predecessor was the abandonment of the milled receiver in favor of a stamped one, which reduced the weight of the weapon. The stock is raised to bring the buttstock closer to the firing line.
The rifle is equipped with a modified telescopic sight for sniper fire. It is an integrated telescopic sight, which has a higher magnification than standard sights.
This assault rifle is also equipped with an integrated underbarrel grenade launcher, making it an even more versatile weapon.
Underbarrel grenade launcher for assault rifles used in Warsaw Pact countries.\nAmmunition - VOG-25\ngrenade and VOG-25P grenade.
Underbarrel grenade launcher for NATO rifles.\nAmmunition - M203 grenades.
Widespread Soviet-made telescopic sight. It uses the standard dovetail mount for the Warsaw Pact countries.
4x telescopic sight, produced in NATO countries. Mounted on the standard NATO mount, the so-called Picatinny rail.
Effective silencer, collected in the Zone by some skillful people. It comes with a set of adapters for weapons of any caliber.

Folding assault rifle of 1974 model for 5,45x39 mm cartridge. It is a simple and reliable weapon, although the cheapness of production has somewhat affected the ease of use and accuracy of combat. In the Zone it is the main weapon of military stalkers and many loners.
Ammunition:
regular 5.45x39mm,
armor-piercing 5.45x39mm BP.
Modified bolt mechanism increases the rate of fire.

By its dimensions and weight the AKS-74U is close to a submachine gun, but the principle of operation of the mechanism of this weapon and the cartridge used in it make it a representative of the submachine gun class. The advantages are small size, which is very useful in urban combat, and high penetration capability of the cartridge. The main disadvantages are short sighting range and tendency to overheat quickly when firing in bursts.
Ammunition:
conventional 5.45x39mm,
armor-piercing 5.45x39mm BP.

The weapon is in service with the U.S. military and police forces, as well as many paramilitary and law enforcement units around the world. It is equally popular with criminal organizations due to its powerful cartridge and large magazine capacity.
Ammunition:
basic 9x19mm Parabellum,
enhanced 9x19mm PBP.

This gun is one of the most common weapons for beginners.
Ammunition:
12x70 shot,
12x76 slug,
12x76 dart.

Classic automatic Colt, which passed with honor all armed conflicts of the XX century and confidently entered the new century. The low magazine capacity is compensated to a certain extent by the use of a powerful cartridge.
Ammunition:
regular 11.43x23 FMJ,
improved 11.43x23 "HydroShock".

A real gun for real heroes. Big, heavy and extremely killing. Because of the price and size is not very popular in the Zone, but not every day you hunt an elephant.
Ammunition:
regular .45 ACP,
enhanced .45 ACP HydroShock.

F2000 with computerized fire control module sight and 40mm grenade launcher.
Ammunition:
conventional 5.56x45mm SS109,
armor-piercing 5.56x45mm AR.

The Fort 12 pistol is a police pistol to replace morally and physically obsolete PM (Makarov) pistols of the Soviet era. It has better accuracy than the PM, larger magazine capacity and more comfortable grip.
Ammunition:
basic 9x18mm,
improved 9x18mm PMM.

German-made assault rifle, which is a first-class example of modern weaponry - lightweight, reliable and ergonomic.
Ammunition:
conventional 5.56x45mm SS109,
armor-piercing 5.56x45mm AR.

A super-precision weapon that the designers in the Zone put together. Operates almost silently, as it uses artifact energy rather than gunpowder gases to fire. Despite the colossal power of the shot, the recoil of the Gauss cannon is very low. It is superior in accuracy and killing power to any classical firearm.\nAmmunition is 2mm gauss ammunition.

The automatic grenade launcher is a very successful variant of the assault rifle in the Zone: compact, reliable, and at the same time versatile and powerful. Thunderstorm is a favorite of military stalkers.
Ammunition:
regular 9x39mm PAB-9,
armor-piercing 9x39mm SP-6,
sniper 9x39mm SP-5,
underbarrel grenades VOG-25 and VOG-25P.

Produced by Belgian company FN Erstal. Browning HP (High Power) pistols are designed for police and military use. They are in service in more than 100 countries of the world. Browning High Power is deservedly considered one of the best pistols of the twentieth century.
Ammunition:
basic 9x19mm Parabellum,
enhanced 9x19mm PBP.
Hunting knife. Indispensable weapon if you need to take someone out quietly.

After this rifle was replaced by German G36 by the British Army, it surfaced in large numbers on the black market and then in the Zone. The main advantages of the L85 are the standard 4x scope and high accuracy of the first shot. When firing in bursts, the accuracy of the rifle drops drastically, and the reliability of its main mechanisms is not high enough.
Ammunition:
conventional 5.56x45mm SS109,
armor-piercing 5.56x45mm AR.

The latest development of the American company Z-M Weapons, whose owner Allan Zitta is well known in gun circles for his many years of experience in technical improvement of combat and sporting pistols based on the .Colt. М 1911. The LR-300 is nothing less than a new step in the development of the AR-15. LR-300 stands for Lightweight Rifle for effective fire up to 300 meters. Compared to the AR-15, the LR-300 uses shorter gas system, significantly modified gas ejection system and completely reconstructed upper bolt carrier.
Ammunition:
conventional 5.56x45mm SS109,
armor-piercing 5.56x45mm AR.

One of the best weapons in the submachine gun class. During the last decades of XX century it was adopted by special forces of the army and police in many countries of the world. With the beginning of its gradual replacement by more modern models began to appear frequently on the black market, from where the masses got into the Zone.
Ammunition:
basic 9x19mm Parabellum,
improved 9x19mm PBP.

HK 53 - HK33KA3 variant with shortened to 211mm barrel, extended four-slot flame arrester and forend similar to HK MP5. No underbarrel grenade launcher or bayonet knife can be installed. Manufactured since 1975 and used by special forces.
Ammunition:
conventional 5.56x45mm SS109,
armor-piercing 5.56x45mm AR.

A pistol with integrated silencer, once used by the Soviet Special Forces. Morally obsolete, but still quite effective in skilled hands.
Ammunition:
basic 9x18mm,
improved 9x18mm PMM.

Designed for arming militia. Developed and produced since 1994 by Izhevsk factory (Russia).
Ammunition:
basic 9x18mm,
improved 9x18mm PMM.

Revolver-type grenade launcher. Sometimes simply indispensable, in particular when clearing large areas from mutants, attacking guarded stationary objects, in combat with particularly tenacious creatures.\nAmmunition - VOG-25 grenade,\nand VOG-25P grenade.

Grenade launcher of the 1960s, in huge quantities left in army warehouses, from where it got into the Zone. It is a rare weapon for stalkers: its impressive size and heavy weight make it not too popular, although for some missions it is indispensable.\nAmmunition - OG-7B.

This model was developed back in 1975, but it is still popular all over the world. The magazine is not big enough, but the mechanism is as reliable as a Swiss watch; the second advantage is the use of the powerful Colt cartridge.
Ammunition:
regular 11.43x23 FMJ,
enhanced 11.43x23 HydroShock.

One of the relatively new Swiss assault rifles chambered for the 5.56x45mm SS109 cartridge. Accuracy, soft recoil and high reliability of this weapon quickly gained it the widest popularity.
Ammunition:
regular 5.56x45 mm SS109,
armor-piercing 5.56x45 mm AR.

The SPAS-12 shotgun was developed in the late 1970s as a universal combat weapon for police and assault units of the army. This weapon is characterized by high reliability and flexibility of use; on the other hand, it is rather massive, complicated and expensive. It is probably the best weapon for close combat in the Zone.
Ammunition:
12x70 buckshot,
12x76 slug,
12x76 dart.

Sniper Rifle. Widely used in all combat operations by Soviet and Russian armies since 1960s. It has proven to be an extremely reliable and easy to handle weapon. In the Zone it is especially favored by the experienced stalkers of the "Duty" group.
Ammunition:
regular 7.62x54 mm 7H1,
armor-piercing 7.62x54 mm BP,
sniper 7.62x54 mm 7H14.

A more modern version of the rifle, made in a compact bullpup pattern. Very good for long journeys in the Zone.
Ammunition:
regular 7.62x54 mm 7N1,
armor-piercing 7.62x54 mm BP,
sniper 7.62x54 mm 7N14.

The TOZ-34 is a two-barrel lightweight hunting rifle with low barrels, designed for commercial and recreational hunting. It has been in production since 1964 at the Tula Gun Factory.
Ammunition:
12x70 shot,
12x76 slug,
12x76 dart.

Solid barrel. German quality and reliability. Compact weapon of close combat. Particularly popular among veterans of the Zone. Variant for 0.45ACP caliber. The magazine capacity is 8 rounds.
Ammunition:
regular 11.43x23 FMJ,
improved 11.43x23 HydroShock.

This rifle is based on the "Vintorez" silenced sniper rifle, and differs from it by its folding buttstock, the ability to fire in bursts, and a larger magazine. The Vintorez rifle was originally intended for use by special forces in attack situations requiring silent and flameless fire.
Ammunition:
conventional 9x39mm PAB-9,
armor-piercing 9x39mm SP-6,
sniper 9x39mm SP-5.

The VSS Vintorez (Special Vintorez Sniper Rifle) was developed on the basis of the AS Val by designers P. Serdyukov and V. Krasnikov at the Central Research Institute of Precision Engineering and adopted into service in 1987. The Vintorez is designed for silent and flameless sniper shooting.
Ammunition:
conventional 9x39mm PAB-9,
armor-piercing 9x39mm SP-6,
sniper 9x39mm SP-5.

Excellent German-made pistol with high reliability, large magazine capacity and good accuracy, especially in this version - for 9mm Parabellum cartridge.
Ammunition:
basic 9x19mm Parabellum,
improved 9x19mm PBP.

American-made pump action shotgun, designed for use in the most unfavorable conditions and characterized by high reliability. All parts are anti-corrosion coated.
Ammunition:
12x70 shot,
12x76 buckshot,
12x76 dart.
Stalker, nicknamed Lom, used to work as a mechanic at a locksmith factory. He made small changes to the design of his AK-74M, which increased the weapon's rate of fire.

The rifle is a sniper rifle, special, modernized. It is designed for silent and flameless sniper shooting, and is equipped with an integrated silencer. The trigger mechanism was modified to reduce wear and tear during firing, and the magazine was increased to 20 rounds. The magazine has been enlarged to 20 rounds.

Unshortened version of the BM-16 rifle. It differs from the Shotgun in its accuracy and accuracy. Suitable for hunting wild boars and larger animals. Often seen at beginners and on sale at traders.
Ammunition:
12x70 shot,
12x76 slug,
12x76 dart.

Belgian submachine gun, developed in the 1980s by FN Herstal. Despite its unusual appearance, quite effective. The FN P90 was rather quickly redesigned for a special 5.56x45mm cartridge, which has more penetration power than other pistol cartridges. The weapon is easy to use and has extremely low recoil.
Ammunition:
regular 5.56x45mm SS109,
armor-piercing 5.56x45mm AR.

This weapon is usually used by heavily armed units of military stalkers. It is extremely rare in the Zone, due to its large size and weight, which sometimes requires wearing an exoskeleton for handheld shooting.\nAmmunition:\narmor-piercing 7.62x54mm APC.

The APS is an automatic pistol developed in the late 1940s and early 1950s and adopted by the Soviet Armed Forces in 1951, at the same time as the Makarov pistol. The APS is designed to arm officers directly involved in combat operations, as well as soldiers and sergeants of some special units.
- 9x18mm, 9x18mm BMP
- effective range 100m
- magazine capacity 20 rounds\

RGO (GRAU index - 7G22) - hand-held anti-personnel defensive shock and distance grenade. The grenade is designed to engage manpower in defensive combat. The grenade is delivered to the target only by throwing it from the user's hand. The grenade's fragmentation radius is 50 meters, and the radius of lethality is 100 meters. The grenade is similar to the F-1 grenade, but differs from it by the use of a combined shock and remote detonator. The grenade explodes upon impact with a hard surface. The grenade's fuze is all-dual, and is detonated regardless of surface inclination or grenade position. The fuse is cocked 1.3-1.8 seconds after the safety lever is released (grenade throw), which eliminates the possibility of instantaneous explosion in case of accidental encounter with an obstacle at a short distance from the grenade launcher. If the grenade is not detonated by the impact fuze, the grenade is self-destructed by detonation 3.2-4.2 seconds after the safety lever is released. In this case the action of the grenade is completely similar to that of the F-1, RG-42, RGD-5 grenades. The combat grenade is colored olive-grayish. The simulation grenade is colored black.
